document.note: [Confidential] Reflecting Pakistan's post-9/11 policy change, a DIA source discusses Pakistan and Musharraf's support for the fight against terrorism. Assisting the US serves Pakistan's self-interest and Pakistan wants recognition and assistance for its commitment.

key_claims: Source claims most Pakistanis and all senior military commanders back Musharraf's support for the anti-terror coalition.
Pakistan closed the Al Rashid computer school and HuM Lahore office on 2 Oct 2001 due to Taliban ties.
Source claims al-Qa'ida has produced only rudimentary chemical and biological agents in Afghanistan.
Afghan refugees in Pakistan are said to be unsympathetic to the Taliban and UBL.
Pakistani leaders fear India will exploit the crisis over Kashmir.
